mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings (user_id, new_place, schedule_change, member_join, ai_recommend, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{newPlace}, #{scheduleChange}, #{memberJoin}, #{aiRecommend}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET new_place = #{newPlace}, schedule_change = #{scheduleChange}, member_join = #{memberJoin}, ai_recommend = #{aiRecommend}, updated_at = NOW()
